question: Which Indian city hosted the final match of the Women's Premier League (Cricket) 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• **Mumbai**, the financial capital of India, hosted the final match of the **Women's Premier League (Cricket) 2025**. The city is renowned for its world-class cricket infrastructure.

• The **Wankhede Stadium**, located in Mumbai, is a premier cricket venue with a seating capacity of over **30,000**. It has hosted iconic matches, including the **ICC Cricket World Cup 2011 Final**.

• The **Women's Premier League (WPL)**, modeled after the IPL, is an annual cricket tournament aimed at promoting **women’s cricket** and providing a platform for showcasing talent.

• Mumbai's established cricketing ecosystem, vibrant fan base, and excellent facilities make it a preferred choice for hosting high-profile matches.

• The WPL final in Mumbai highlights the city's pivotal role in fostering cricket in India, especially in the domain of **women’s sports**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Women's Premier League (WPL):**

• The WPL was launched in **2023** by the **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)**.

• The league aims to promote **women’s cricket** and provide a platform for domestic and international players.

• It follows an auction-based team selection model and features multiple franchises representing various Indian cities.

• **Mumbai as a Cricketing Hub:**

• Mumbai has a rich cricketing legacy and is home to cricket legends like **Sachin Tendulkar** and **Sunil Gavaskar**.

• The city houses two iconic stadiums: **Wankhede Stadium** and **Brabourne Stadium**, which regularly host international and domestic matches.

• These venues have state-of-the-art facilities and provide a world-class experience for players and spectators alike.

• **Other Cities:**

• **Chennai:** Known for the **MA Chidambaram Stadium**, it has a strong cricket culture but was not chosen for the WPL 2025 final.

• **Kolkata:** The **Eden Gardens**, one of the largest cricket stadiums globally, did not host the WPL 2025 final.

• **Vadodara:** While Vadodara has a cricketing tradition, it lacks the infrastructure required for hosting high-profile matches like the WPL final.

• **Significance of WPL:**

• The WPL has played a crucial role in breaking **gender barriers** and promoting women’s participation in cricket.

• It has increased the visibility of women’s cricket, attracting more viewership and sponsorships.

• Young girls aspiring to play cricket now have a professional platform to showcase their talent and gain international recognition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **Wankhede Stadium:**

• Located in **South Mumbai**, it is one of India’s premier cricket venues.

• It has hosted several iconic matches, including the **2011 ICC Cricket World Cup Final**, where India emerged victorious.

• It is known for its electrifying crowd atmosphere and modern facilities.

• **Growth of Women’s Cricket in India:**

• Women’s cricket gained momentum after India finished as **runners-up** in the **2017 ICC Women’s Cricket World Cup**.

• Players like **Mithali Raj** and **Harmanpreet Kaur** have been instrumental in raising the profile of women’s cricket in India.

• The WPL is a crucial step towards establishing a strong pipeline of talent for women’s cricket in India.
